name: Jam (Strawberry)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small amounts as strawberries are low FODMAP, though high sugar content may cause symptoms in some sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check labels for high fructose corn syrup or honey which would make it high FODMAP
Choose brands with simple ingredients: strawberries, sugar, pectin
Store opened jam in refrigerator and use within recommended timeframe
Consider sugar-free versions but check for polyol sweeteners like sorbitol
alternatives: Fresh strawberries with a sprinkle of sugar
Low FODMAP berry compote made at home
nutritionalHighlights: Provides quick energy from natural sugars
Contains small amounts of antioxidants from berries
